preconditions.description: The number of red pixels must be between 0 and 2^31.
The number of green pixels must be between 0 and 2^31.
The number of blue pixels must be between 0 and 2^31.
The total number of pixels must be greater than 0.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(-1) if max(a, b, c) > a + b + c - max(a, b, c) else stdout == str(max(a, b, c) - (a + b + c - max(a, b, c)))
postconditions.description: If the maximum number of pixels of any color is greater than the sum of the other two colors, output -1; otherwise, output the minimum number of fights needed.
